title: The Hidden Burden of Bad Science: Estimating the Global Scale and Downstream Cost of Research Integrity Failures
domain: meta-research / science of science / bibliometrics / research integrity / causal inference
summary: A global, uncertainty-aware meta-research program with a completed public-data denominator/correction pilot and a real probability-traceable 1,339-work Pilot B seed frame; it separates confirmed misconduct, severe scientific reliability failures, publication-process failures and broader research waste, then estimates prevalence and downstream burden only after detector calibration and independent adjudication.

aris.provenance: ARIS4C guided run; web/Scite evidence retrieval with explicit tool-availability logging; PuddingSkill-style evidence dossier principles
